Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner swapped the directors’ birth dates when summarizing: assigned 1929-12-21 to Jean Yarbrough and 1900-08-22 to Takhir Sabirov, reversing the correct data provided by WebSurfer. This transposition led to the incorrect conclusion that The Last Night of Scheherazade’s director was born first, whereas Jean Yarbrough (Leave It to Henry) was actually born earlier.
